single_increment: replace only the action objective with the fixed 5-session label; no threshold/cost/model/window search

training.label: fixed 5-session label_5d_bps from the frozen diagnostic card
training.join: complete unique signal_date between e4 training_rows_control and diag labels_10
training.continuation: original frozen net_value router (off-policy offset is an explicit limitation)
training.not_claiming: the candidate's own on-policy multi-day label; training uses frozen parent state
training.maturity: candidate label_available_at = 5th segment exit 09:30; strictly before NY Jan-1 and first same-year decision
training.unknown_policy: unknown/cross-year rows are excluded from fits, never filled with 0; kept and counted

evaluation.outer: reused_diagnostic (already inspected; never a fresh OOS claim)
evaluation.gates: original nine gates + SOXX same-cost returns/DD/Sharpe/annual win rate/relative wealth + 20-session paired block uncertainty (windows separate)
evaluation.native: real Qlib prefix(day)+suffix(15min), post_fee_desired, prefix cash/quantity handoff; candidate native failure => needs_data/blocked

stop_rule: if economic gates fail or CI unclear -> not_promoted and end_fixed_label_route_no_parameter_search; if seemingly passing still needs independent forward, no production switch
